newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to privatise banks, Bezeq in 97-officials.
newsitem.headline: Israel to privatise banks, Bezeq in 97-officials.

text.p: Israel's three largest commercial banks and its main telecommunications company are slated for further privatisation next year, government officials said.

The timing of the sale of Bank Hapoalim, Bank Leumi, Israel Discount Bank and Bezeq Israel Telecom was taken on Tuesday by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in consultation with the head of the Government Corporations Authority, Tzipi Livni, and other officials.
In addition, Netanyahu agreed to sell government holdings in Israel Chemicals Ltd, Zim Israel Navigation, the Israel Standards Institute and the Tourism Development Corp.
All told, the sales are expected to bring in four billion shekels in revenues, the officials said.
Since taking office in June, Netanyahu has pledged to reinvigorate Israel's privatisation programme, saying he was dedicated to liberalising the Jewish state's economy.
A complete privatisation programme was due to be unveiled in November, but the officials said it would now likely occur in the next few weeks, they said.
